name: Site exploration review
description: Explore a site through safe links and leave evidence-backed product feedback. Requires a running app, Playwright browser, and LangGraph.

parameters.label: Evaluation name
parameters.tooltip: Name the build that OpenOrbit creates for this recurring evaluation.

parameters.label: Target repository
parameters.tooltip: Absolute path to the local repository or workspace that this evaluation may inspect.

parameters.label: Browser base URL
parameters.tooltip: Public URL that Playwright opens while collecting browser evidence. Leave blank only when this Quick Start does not use a browser.

parameters.label: Review focus
parameters.tooltip: Product experience, route, or concern the site review should prioritize.

parameters.label: AI model profile name
parameters.tooltip: Name for the model profile that this Quick Start creates and assigns to the build.

parameters.label: AI provider
parameters.tooltip: Select the provider that serves the supervisor and, where applicable, target AI model.

parameters.label: Model / deployment
parameters.tooltip: Provider model ID or deployment name used for evaluation.

parameters.label: Provider endpoint
parameters.tooltip: Provider base endpoint. Azure OpenAI requires this; Bedrock can leave it blank.

parameters.label: Region
parameters.tooltip: Cloud region used by the selected provider, such as eastus or us-east-1.

parameters.label: API key environment variable
parameters.tooltip: Name of the environment variable that holds the provider API key or credentials.

runner.name: ${build_name} runner
runner.description: LangGraph site exploration runner created by Quick Start.

prompt_template.name: ${build_name} policy
prompt_template.content: Review the site-exploration evidence for ${review_focus}. Give an evidence-backed product opinion and report reproducible friction or defects only.

test_case_set.name: ${build_name} exploration
test_case_set.description: Bounded site exploration created by Quick Start.

build.name: ${build_name}
build.purpose: Explore a site and assess the rendered experience.
